relationship: Separate forward evaluation; does not replace or rewrite the frozen native, sanjaya_available, or sanjaya_guided records.

design.promptTreatment: identical task prompt in both arms; no explicit skill name, plugin name, or Sanjaya-use instruction

controls.hardTokenLimitReason: codex-cli 0.144.5 does not expose a per-exec token cap; the harness stops between runs at the separately approved aggregate ceiling
controls.rawEvents: temporary local files only; never committed
controls.pluginInstallation: exact reviewed local plugin installed into a new disposable CODEX_HOME before every skill-arm session
controls.userConfiguration: no personal CODEX_HOME, config.toml, rules, skills, plugins, memories, or session history is loaded

indexing.warm: built with the exact public package before the measured session in a separate treatment snapshot
indexing.none: no index exists at session start
indexing.cost: measured separately and never charged only to a query
indexing.sourceSnapshotIsolation: the agent sees a pristine read-only snapshot; the MCP server uses an equivalent treatment snapshot so .sanjaya never leaks to the native arm
indexing.writeRule: any measured index creation or mutation is recorded as an index write and fails the skill-side-effect gate

scoring.citationRule: same repository-relative path and overlapping accepted line range
scoring.forbiddenClaimRule: only preregistered claim-key and rejected-value pairs are mechanically counted
scoring.proseLimitation: free-form prose is retained for review but is not semantically judged by a model

gates.correctness: skill strict success and mean claim F1 must not regress against the fresh native control
gates.citations: mean citation validity must not regress against the fresh native control
gates.selectiveRouting: completed skill runs must include both native-only and Sanjaya-using sessions
gates.sideEffects: zero index writes during measured sessions
gates.failures: timeouts, invalid output, agent errors, harness errors, neutral results, and regressions remain in the denominator and report
